directAnswer: You can rename multiple files at once using built-in file management tools or command line utilities, depending on your operating system.
summary: This guide provides methods to rename multiple files simultaneously on different platforms, including Windows and macOS.

sections.heading: Renaming Files in Windows File Explorer
sections.body: In Windows, you can select multiple files, right-click, and choose 'Rename' to rename them sequentially. You can also use PowerShell for more complex renaming patterns.

sections.heading: Renaming Files in macOS Finder
sections.body: On macOS, select the files, right-click, and choose 'Rename X Items...' to apply a batch rename. You can also use the Terminal for advanced renaming.

steps.title: Using Windows File Explorer
steps.detail: 1. Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder containing the files. 2. Select the files you want to rename. 3. Right-click and select 'Rename' or press F2. 4. Enter a new name and press Enter; Windows will auto-increment the names.

steps.title: Using macOS Finder
steps.detail: 1. Open Finder and navigate to the folder with the files. 2. Select the files you want to rename. 3. Right-click and choose 'Rename X Items...'. 4. Choose a format for renaming and apply.

steps.title: Using PowerShell on Windows
steps.detail: 1. Open PowerShell. 2. Navigate to the folder using 'cd path_to_folder'. 3. Use the command 'Get-ChildItem | Rename-Item -NewName { $_.Name -replace 'old','new' }' to rename files based on a pattern.

steps.title: Using Terminal on macOS
steps.detail: 1. Open Terminal. 2. Navigate to the folder using 'cd path_to_folder'. 3. Use the command 'for f in *; do mv ""$f" "new_prefix_$f"; done' to rename files with a prefix.

faqs.question: Can I undo a bulk rename operation?
faqs.answer: Typically, there is no built-in undo for bulk rename operations. It's advisable to back up files before renaming.

faqs.question: What if the filenames exceed the character limit?
faqs.answer: If filenames exceed the character limit, you may need to shorten them manually or use a script to adjust them.

faqs.question: Are there third-party tools for bulk renaming?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are several third-party tools like Bulk Rename Utility for Windows and NameChanger for macOS that offer advanced bulk renaming features.

caveats: Renaming files can affect links or references to those files in applications or systems.
